title: Strings that start like a YAML construct
notes: Each of these is a different value or a syntax error when plain: an entry, a key, a comment, an anchor, an alias, a tag, a block scalar header, a directive, a reserved indicator, a quote, a flow collection or a document marker. They are quoted. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).
